title: Let the Court decide what honor is
summary: Love-filled service is what the Lord's Court honors. Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
takeaway: Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
lifeApplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, speak to the Lord as one already being held.

source.shortMeaning: Love-filled service is what the Lord's Court honors.
source.lifeApplication: Before angling for credit, do one loving act no one can repay.

evidence.coreClaim: Love-filled service is what the Lord's Court honors.
evidence.turn: Move toward the humble until fear loses its command.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, speak to the Lord as one already being held.
